autostartFailedBody: Unable to confirm the startup setting: {error}
dataInUse: Another SelfAnalyst instance is using this data directory. Close that instance first.
dataLockUnavailable: Cannot acquire the data directory lock. Check permissions and the filesystem.
dataFormatUnsupported: This application does not support the data format. Use a compatible version.
dataFormatInvalid: Cannot verify the data format. Close the older application normally and check the data and format marker. Existing data was not overwritten.
dataRootUnavailable: The runtime directory or portable marker is unavailable. Check permissions and portable.marker.
startupFailedBody: The application could not start. See the local startup and backend logs for details.
